newsitem.title: CHINA: China says it has 709,000 private firms.
newsitem.headline: China says it has 709,000 private firms.

text.p: China had 709,000 private firms employing a total of 10.14 million people as of the end of June, the Xinhua news agency said.
That is up from the 654,000 private firms employing 8.22 million people at the end of last year, according to previously announced figures.
Those firms, most of them in the service sector, had a total annual output value of more than 229.5 billion yuan ($27.6 billion) last year.
Private firms in China are defined as those employing at least eight people. Those employing fewer people are considered to be individual traders, officials said.
The number of private individual traders reached 24.74 million employing a total of 45.44 million people at the end of June, Xinhua said.
